    Test for Homogeneity of Multivariate Dispersions via vegan::betadisper

    run_betadisper.Rd

    Quantifies and tests within-group multivariate dispersion using vegan::betadisper and permutation tests, returning tidy summary tibbles.

    Usage

    run_betadisper(
  tb,
  group,
  assay = "counts",
  method = "bray",
  permutations = 999,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    tb

    A tidy_microbiome object.

    group

    Character string naming the grouping variable in sample metadata.

    assay

    Assay name to use. Defaults to "counts".

    method

    Distance metric to compute (e.g. "bray", "jaccard"). Defaults to "bray".

    permutations

    Number of permutations for dispersion test. Defaults to 999.

    ...

    Additional arguments passed to vegan::betadisper.

    Value

    An S3 object of class tidybiome_betadisper containing:

    • sample_distances: Tibble with sample_id, group, and distance_to_centroid.

    • group_summary: Tibble with per-group counts, mean distances, and standard errors.

    • test: Tibble with F-statistic, degrees of freedom, and permutation p-value.
